fallback.notes: No curated guide for this merchant yet. Universal playbook: log in, find Billing/Subscription settings, cancel, screenshot the confirmation.

adobe.name: Adobe Creative Cloud
adobe.notes: Cancelling an annual plan early can trigger an early-termination fee (often 50% of remaining months). Check your plan terms first.
steps: Go to account.adobe.com/plans and sign in.
Click Manage plan, then Cancel your plan.
Work through the retention offers until the final cancel confirmation.

amazon_prime.name: Amazon Prime
amazon_prime.notes: If you used Prime benefits, Amazon may offer a partial refund on 'End now'.
steps: Go to amazon.com/gp/primecentral and sign in.
Click Manage Membership, then End Membership.
Work through the retention screens (End now / End on renewal date) and confirm.

apple_services.name: Apple subscriptions
apple_services.notes: Covers iCloud+, Apple Music, Apple TV+, and App Store-billed third-party apps.
steps: On iPhone/iPad: Settings, tap your name, then Subscriptions.
Select the subscription and tap Cancel Subscription.
On Mac: App Store, click your name, Account Settings, Manage under Subscriptions.

audible.name: Audible
audible.notes: Desktop only; the mobile app redirects you to the website.
steps: Go to audible.com/account/cancel on desktop and sign in.
Click Cancel Membership and follow the prompts.
Use any remaining credits first — they expire when membership ends.

babbel.name: Babbel
steps: Log in at babbel.com and open Profile & Settings.
Go to Account Information and cancel the subscription.
Confirm via the email link Babbel sends.

calm.name: Calm
steps: Log in at calm.com and open Settings.
Go to Manage Subscription, then Cancel.
Confirm the cancellation.

canva.name: Canva
steps: Go to canva.com/account/billing and sign in.
Click Cancel subscription under your plan.
Follow the prompts to confirm.

chatgpt_plus.name: ChatGPT Plus
chatgpt_plus.notes: Apple-billed subscriptions: cancel in iPhone Settings > Subscriptions.
steps: Log in at chatgpt.com, click your profile, then Settings.
Open Subscription, then click Manage.
Click Cancel plan and confirm.

costco.name: Costco
costco.notes: Full refund of the membership fee is available any time you're dissatisfied.
steps: Call Costco Member Services or visit any warehouse membership counter.
Request cancellation of your membership.
Costco refunds the membership fee in full if you are dissatisfied, at any time.

coursera.name: Coursera
steps: Log in at coursera.org, open your profile, then My Purchases.
Select the subscription, then Cancel.
Confirm the cancellation.

crunch.name: Crunch Fitness
crunch.notes: Franchise locations differ; your home club's policy governs.
steps: Check your membership agreement for the notice period (often 30 days).
Cancel at your home club in person or by certified mail per the agreement.
Get written confirmation and check statements afterwards.

crunchyroll.name: Crunchyroll
steps: Go to crunchyroll.com, open your profile, then My Account.
Under Membership Plan, click Cancel Membership.
Confirm the cancellation.

disney_plus.name: Disney+
disney_plus.notes: If billed via Apple/Google Play/Roku/Amazon, cancel in that platform instead.
steps: Log in at disneyplus.com, click your profile icon, then Account.
Select your Disney+ subscription under Subscription.
Choose Cancel Subscription, then Complete Cancellation.
You keep access until the end of the current billing cycle.

doordash.name: DoorDash DashPass
steps: Open the DoorDash app or site, go to Account, then Manage DashPass.
Select End Subscription.
Confirm the cancellation.

dropbox.name: Dropbox
steps: Go to dropbox.com/account/billing and sign in.
Under Billing period, click Cancel plan.
Confirm the downgrade to Basic.

duolingo.name: Duolingo
steps: Go to duolingo.com/settings and open the Super Duolingo section.
Click Cancel Subscription and confirm.
Mobile purchases: cancel in the App Store or Play Store subscriptions.

espn_plus.name: ESPN+
steps: Log in at plus.espn.com and open your profile.
Go to ESPN+ Subscriptions, then Manage.
Select Cancel Subscription and confirm.

figma.name: Figma
figma.notes: Only organization admins can change billing.
steps: Go to figma.com/settings and open the Billing tab.
Click Downgrade or Cancel plan.
Confirm the change.

github.name: GitHub
github.notes: Covers Copilot and Codespaces usage plans too.
steps: Go to github.com/settings/billing.
Under your plan, click Edit or Downgrade.
Follow the prompts to downgrade to Free.

goodlife.name: GoodLife Fitness
goodlife.notes: Cancellation terms vary by membership type; written confirmation is essential.
steps: Log in to My GoodLife at goodlifefitness.com.
Check your membership terms and notice period.
Submit a cancellation request through Member Services or visit your home club; get written confirmation.

google_one.name: Google One
google_one.notes: Play Store subscriptions: Play Store app, profile icon, Payments & subscriptions, Subscriptions.
steps: Go to one.google.com/settings and sign in.
Click Cancel membership and follow the prompts.
You keep storage until the end of the billing period.

grammarly.name: Grammarly
steps: Log in at grammarly.com, open Account, then Subscription.
Click Cancel Subscription.
Confirm the cancellation.

headspace.name: Headspace
steps: Go to headspace.com/settings and sign in.
Click Cancel Subscription.
Confirm the cancellation.

hellofresh.name: HelloFresh
hellofresh.notes: Skipping weeks instead of cancelling is offered as an alternative.
steps: Log in at hellofresh.com and open Account Settings.
Scroll to Plan settings and click Cancel Plan.
Follow the prompts; cancel at least 5 days before your next delivery.

hulu.name: Hulu
hulu.notes: Third-party-billed accounts (Roku, Amazon, Apple) must cancel through that provider.
steps: Log in at hulu.com/account.
Under Your Subscription, select Cancel.
Decline any pause offers with Continue to Cancel, then Cancel Subscription.

instacart.name: Instacart+
steps: Open Instacart, tap the menu, then Instacart+.
Select Cancel membership at the bottom.
Confirm the cancellation.

linkedin_premium.name: LinkedIn Premium
steps: Go to linkedin.com/premium/manage.
Click Cancel subscription under Manage Premium account.
Confirm the cancellation.

masterclass.name: MasterClass
masterclass.notes: Annual plans are generally not refunded mid-term.
steps: Go to masterclass.com/settings/subscription.
Click Cancel under your membership.
Follow the prompts to confirm.

max_hbo.name: Max (HBO)
max_hbo.notes: Third-party-billed accounts cancel through that provider.
steps: Log in at max.com, open your profile, then Settings.
Choose Subscription, then Manage Subscription.
Select Cancel Subscription and confirm.

microsoft_365.name: Microsoft 365
microsoft_365.notes: Also covers Xbox Game Pass and PC Game Pass.
steps: Go to account.microsoft.com/services and sign in.
Find the subscription and click Manage, then Cancel subscription.
Confirm on the next screen.

netflix.name: Netflix
netflix.notes: If billed via Apple/Google Play, cancel in that platform's subscription settings instead.
steps: Go to netflix.com/cancelplan and sign in.
Click Cancel Membership.
Click Finish Cancellation and confirm.
Save the confirmation email; you keep access until the end of the billing period.

notion.name: Notion
steps: Open Notion, go to Settings & members, then Billing.
Click Cancel plan or downgrade to the free plan.
Confirm the change.

nyt.name: New York Times
steps: Log in at nytimes.com and open your Account page.
Under Subscription Overview, select Cancel Subscription.
Confirm; chat support is available if the button is missing.

paramount_plus.name: Paramount+
steps: Go to paramountplus.com/account and sign in.
Click Cancel Subscription.
Confirm the cancellation.

patreon.name: Patreon
patreon.notes: Memberships are per-creator; repeat for each creator.
steps: Go to patreon.com/settings/memberships.
Click Edit next to the membership, then Cancel membership.
Confirm the cancellation.

peacock.name: Peacock
steps: Go to peacocktv.com/account and sign in.
Under Plans & Payment, click Cancel Plan.
Confirm the cancellation.

peloton.name: Peloton
steps: Go to members.onepeloton.com/subscription and sign in.
Click Cancel Subscription.
Confirm; access continues to the end of the billing period.

planet_fitness.name: Planet Fitness
planet_fitness.notes: Many clubs only accept in-person or written cancellation. No-commitment memberships have no cancellation fee, but notice deadlines still apply.
steps: Log in at planetfitness.com and open My Account, then Manage Membership.
If a Cancel option appears, follow the prompts and screenshot the confirmation.
If not: visit your home club in person or send a certified letter to your home club requesting cancellation.
Check statements afterwards; watch the $49 annual fee date.

slack.name: Slack
slack.notes: Only workspace primary owners can change the plan.
steps: Workspace owners go to my.slack.com/admin/billing.
Click Change plan, then select the Free plan.
Confirm the downgrade.

spotify.name: Spotify
spotify.notes: If billed via Apple/Google Play or a carrier, cancel through them instead.
steps: Log in at spotify.com/account in a browser (cannot be done in the app).
Open Subscription, click Change or Cancel, then Cancel Premium.
Confirm with Yes, cancel.
You keep Premium until the next billing date, then drop to the free tier; playlists are kept.

strava.name: Strava
steps: Go to strava.com/settings/subscription.
Click Cancel under your subscription.
Confirm the cancellation.

the_athletic.name: The Athletic
steps: Go to theathletic.com/account and sign in.
Click Cancel Subscription.
Confirm the cancellation.

twitch.name: Twitch
twitch.notes: Subscriptions are per-channel; repeat for each channel.
steps: Go to twitch.tv/subscriptions.
Click the gear icon next to the subscription.
Choose Don't Renew Subscription and confirm.

uber_one.name: Uber One
steps: Open the Uber app, tap Account, then Uber One.
Tap Manage Membership, then End Membership.
Confirm the cancellation.

wsj.name: Wall Street Journal
steps: Go to customercenter.wsj.com and sign in.
Open My Subscriptions and select Cancel.
Confirm the cancellation.

x_premium.name: X Premium
x_premium.notes: App Store / Play Store purchases must be cancelled in those stores.
steps: Go to x.com/settings/subscriptions.
Select your Premium subscription and choose Cancel.
Confirm the cancellation.

youtube_premium.name: YouTube Premium
youtube_premium.notes: Apple-billed Premium must be cancelled in iPhone Settings > Subscriptions.
steps: Go to youtube.com/paid_memberships and sign in.
Click Manage Membership, then Deactivate, then Continue to Cancel.
Select a reason and confirm.

zoom.name: Zoom
steps: Go to zoom.us/billing and sign in.
Under Current Plan, click Cancel Plan.
Confirm cancellation.

note: Curated cancellation deep-links and steps for common subscription merchants. URLs verified via web research Sep 2026. Merchants not listed here get the generic fallback guide. The connector never cancels anything itself; the user follows these steps.
